8.name: The Crocodile Way
8.overview: Lucia plays hide and seek, The Wiggles sing 'The Crocodile Way' to real crocodiles, Caterina and Anthony find "C" words, and finish with a live performance of 'Who's in the Wiggle House'!

8.name: The Planets in the Solar System
8.overview: Evie learns about space with Anthony followed by a fun song about the planets. Then, Simon shares tasty treats in 'Food Reviews with Shirley Shawn the Unicorn', and the Tree of Wisdom leads a Wiggly dance.

8.name: John the Hairdresser
8.overview: Meet playful meerkats, enjoy a graceful ballet show with Lucia, Evie, and Dorothy the Dinosaur, and watch John test his hairdressing skills with help from the Tree of Wisdom.

8.name: Learning Shapes With Caterina
8.overview: Join in the fun with Lucia, Tsehay, John, Lachy and Simon as they sing and dance about Caterina's favourite shapes! From circles and squares to triangles, learning is fun with catchy tunes and colourful visuals.

8.name: Bubbles!
8.overview: Caterina and Tsehay blow bubbles with Bubbles the Mermaid and turn Wiggle Town into Bubble Town with a bubbly song! Anthony learns the congas from Sir Leslie Longley and plays 'Fruit Salad' with help from the Tree of Wisdom.

8.name: The Name Game
8.overview: Dance to "Hula, Hula Baby" on the beach, play the name game, enjoy a ballet performance with puppets, giggle with Lachy and Anthony and finish with a live rendition of "Watching the Ponies!"

8.name: Lachy's Friend
8.overview: The Wiggles must solve the puzzle of Lachy's mysterious new friend.

8.name: Captain Feathersword's Picnic
8.overview: Sing along to 'Lucia the Koala', join Captain Feathersword's picnic with Wags, and laugh with Lachy and Tsehay's jokes!

8.name: Folding Towels Can Be Fun!
8.overview: Tsehay has fruit in her hat and Lucia has ribbons in her plaits as the Wiggles sing the catchy 'Fruitie In My Hat'! Meanwhile, Lachy helps Simon turn folding laundry into a fun activity.

8.name: Dorothy's Dancing Roses
8.overview: Start the day in the sunshine with 'The Garden Dance (The Ants Are Marching)'. Tsehay shares her rap with Lucia, then Simon, Lachy, and Anthony sing with dancing roses for Dorothy.

8.name: I Spy: Letters and Sounds
8.overview: Jump in with 'Kangaroo Jumping'! Evie teaches Eye Spy, Buddy leads the 'Italian Word Song - A A's', and the Wiggles sing 'The Spring Song'.

8.name: John and Henry's Sea Creature Adventure
8.overview: Join the Wiggles and the Tree of Wisdom for the 'Friendly Greeting Song'! John dives into an underwater adventure with Henry the Octopus to meet sea creatures up close.

8.name: Crossword Puzzle
8.overview: Join the fun with a Wiggly Conga line, a crossword challenge with the Tree of Wisdom and Captain Feathersword, the 'Italian Word Song - O O's', a round of Guess That Animal, and finish with a live 'Bin Night' performance!

8.name: Walk a Million Miles
8.overview: Join Dorothy the Dinosaur and The Wiggles singing her praise in Wiggle Town! Simon and Tsehay get into a walking competition and Simon sets out to 'Walk a Million Miles'.

8.name: Dancing the Hornpipe on the S.S Feathersword
8.overview: Put on your party hats! Lucia and Tsehay teach Captain Feathersword the hornpipe, John explores positive 'P' words, and Tsehay joins a Dorothy DJ Party with Henry the Octopus.

8.name: The Tree of Wisdom's Hat
8.overview: Come along to Dorothy's party! Lachy practices sun safety with the Tree of Wisdom and sings 'If I Had a Hat'. Caterina joins Dorothy's Dance Party for a remix of 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat'.

8.name: Tap Dancing with Lucia
8.overview: The Tree of Wisdom teaches The Wiggles exciting new dance moves! Lucia shows off her tap-dancing skills, leading to a fun song all about her talents.

8.name: Simon Has the Hiccups
8.overview: Join The Wiggles for a day of fun! The Tree of Wisdom shakes its leafy branches, Simon battles hiccups with help from his friends, and everyone heads to the beach for 'Coco Loco'.

8.name: Making a Happy Story
8.overview: Pop into the fun with 'Hot Poppin' Popcorn' and a Tree of Wisdom tune! The Wiggles create a happiness storybook, Lucia joins a Dorothy Dance Party for 'Quack Quack', and the day ends with a lively preschool performance.

8.name: Evie's Insect Adventure
8.overview: It's time to march to some great music! Evie is in the garden looking for insects - with her special tool, a magnifying glass, and she finds lots of Wiggly insects!

8.name: Limbo!
8.overview: Get ready to Wiggle! The Tree of Wisdom joins Evie, Tsehay and John to share their favourite dance moves. Then, Caterina and Lachy help teach the limbo - even Captain Feathersword joins in!

8.name: Playing Fetch with Wags and Captain Feathersword
8.overview: The Wiggles sing along as their pickup truck rolls on by! Captain Feathersword teaches Wags to fetch with hilarious results, then enjoy a live performance of "Move Your Arms Like Henry." Songs

8.name: The Mayor of Wiggle Town
8.overview: It's election day in Wiggle Town! The Wiggles need to vote for the new mayor of Wiggle Town - who will make Wiggle Town Mayor?

8.name: Trimming the Hedges
8.overview: "Sham Sham Poo Poo", shampoo your hair! Lachy turns everyday life into a musical, Rhymin' Simon gets rhyming and the Wiggles enjoy a colourful garden party.

8.name: Bush Doof!
8.overview: Join The Wiggles for more Wiggly fun! Sing along with "Anthony Ant", then watch John host the hilarious game show, Guess That Animal, with Lachy as a contestant.

8.name: The Captain of the Opera
8.overview: Come on down to Wiggle Town! A sparkly adventure full of music, magic and fun! Join Simon, the Opera Captain, Lucia and Tsehay for a musical journey and a live performance of "Teddy Bear Family."

8.name: Easel-y Done!
8.overview: Dance along to the Limbo, explore feelings with Anthony and sing a shapes song. Enjoy Food Reviews With Simon and Shirley Shawn the Unicorn, and a preschool performance of Round the Garden

8.name: The Great Cowbell and Kazoo Duet!
8.overview: Evie shares some of her fave Wiggly books, Lucia plays hide and seek and makes a pasta tambourine, Buddy explores a truck expo, plus Lachy and Simon perform a musical duet on cowbell and kazoo.

8.name: Evie Goes to the Beach
8.overview: A tea party at the park kicks off the fun. Caterina, John and Tsehay create a story starring Evie, then bounce along to Kangaroo Jumping before Simon and Shirley Shawn the Unicorn chat about food.

8.name: Doing the Dishes Is Fun!
8.overview: Simon and Lachy find a way to do the dishes by singing and dancing, while Anthony learns to play the violin and performs Fruit Salad Yummy Yummy and Guess That Animal adds some puppet fun.

8.name: Surf's Up!
8.overview: At the beach, Buddy shows Tsehay, John and Evie how exciting surfing can be. Everyone then sings and dances along to Bush Doof, before Lucia gets creative and makes a colourful pasta necklace.

8.name: The Wiggles Go to the Library
8.overview: The fun begins with Coco Loco by the beach. Evie shares her fave library books that she's just borrowed to celebrate reading, Guess That Animal returns and the Wiggles sing Five Fingered Family.

8.name: Anthony Learns the Theremin!
8.overview: The Tree of Wisdom and The Wiggles celebrate nature with a song, Lachy joins Captain Feathersword for Giggle with a Wiggle, Tsehay teaches the Hokey Pokey, and Anthony learns the theremin.

8.name: Hot Poppin' Popcorn!
8.overview: Get moving with 'Get Ready to Wiggle', sing along to 'Hot Poppin' Popcorn!', enjoy ballet with Evie, Lucia and their puppet friends, and dance along with 'Do the Hokey Pokey'.

8.name: Exercise with The Tree of Wisdom
8.overview: Sing along to 'Dandelion Days in the Sun', enjoy Rhymin' Simon's musical rhymes, and get active with Strong John and The Tree of Wisdom's new exercise routine, which encourages healthy habits.

8.name: Rockin' Robot Marty
8.overview: Get your boots on and ride into Wiggle Town to 'Wiggle Up, Giddy Up'. Anthony introduces his friend Marty the rockin' robot, Lachy and Simon share jokes, and everyone sings and dances to 'Baby Shark'.

8.name: Captain Feathersword's Lost Hat
8.overview: Captain Feathersword needs help finding his missing pirate hat, The Wiggles give their hula hoops a spin and sing 'Hula, Hula Baby' at the beach, and Lucia makes some simple clay sculptures.

8.name: Opposites!
8.overview: The Wiggles set sail aboard the S.S Feathersword for 'Dance the Hornpipe', play a fun game of opposites, and try on hats. 'Shake Your Hips with Wags the Dog' has everyone dancing and wagging along.

8.name: The Wiggly Garage Sale
8.overview: Get ready to play along with Simon in "Simon Says", sing and learn about the planets, and help Anthony and Evie tidy up the Wiggle House before they hold a Wiggly garage sale with a fun surprise.

8.name: Messy Clean
8.overview: Lachy and Simon turn cleaning up into a musical adventure. Rap along with Tsehay, giggle along with Lachy and the Tree of Wisdom, and sing along to a daycare performance of "Wheels on the Bus."

8.name: Wiggly Picnic
8.overview: The Wiggles soak up the sunshine and sing 'The Ants Are Marching'. The beautiful day inspires Simon to plan a picnic, and everyone brings delicious treats, while Lucia creatures colourful collages.

8.name: Dance, Dance, Dance!
8.overview: Evie shares ballet moves before everyone dances their way to Wiggle Town. Captain Feathersword and The Tree of Wisdom explore movements starting with the letter 'D', and Anthony learns the didgeridoo.

8.name: Dorothy the Dinosaur's Party
8.overview: Lachy and Ponso head out for a pony ride before everyone joins Dorothy's Dance Party. Listening to sounds and clues, Lucia plays Guess That Animal, and the Happy Little Toddlers keep the fun going.

8.name: I Spy: Colours
8.overview: Sing and play around with sparkly 'Bubbles', learn I Spy around the Wiggle House to spot colourful items, and join in with 'Anthony Ant'. Then Buddy visits the aquarium for an underwater adventure.

8.name: Captain Feathersword's Pirate Obedience School
8.overview: Dance along with 'Dorothy (Would You Like to Dance)?' and watch Wags the Dog learn new tricks. Explore circles, enjoy Anthony's mandolin version of 'Fruit Salad', and sing along to 'Jingle Bells'.

8.name: Lachy's Famous Stir Fry
8.overview: Shake along to 'Shake Like a Tree', join Lachy as he cooks his famous veggie stir fry after a shopping trip to Buddy's store for ingredients, and sing along to 'Quack Quack'.

8.name: Wiggly News
8.overview: The Tree of Wisdom and Captain Feathersword act out stories from the Wiggly Newspaper in a guessing game. The Happy Little Toddlers make music, Tsehay shares a rap, and everyone hops to it for a song.

8.name: The Amusement Park
8.overview: Tsehay shows off her colourful salsa dance costumes, Lucia sings with cute meerkats, and Buddy explores an amusement park. The Wiggles get marching, there's word fun, and everyone joins a conga line.

8.name: Peek-a-Boo!
8.overview: Sing and play along to 'Peek-a-Boo', hear Tsehay's special rap for Simon, dance with Dorothy the Dinosaur, and watch The Wiggles explore feelings by sharing their drawings.

8.name: Playing Catch with Wags & Captain
8.overview: Sing and move along to 'The Crocodile Way', play Guess That Animal with Baby John and The Tree of Wisdom, enjoy bubble fun, and join Captain Feathersword as he tries to play catch with Wags the Dog.

8.name: Simon's Pickup Truck
8.overview: Shake along to 'Shakin' Like a Leafy Tree' with The Wiggles and The Tree of Wisdom, sing along to 'Pick Up Truck', and explore shapes with the musical fun of 'A Square Has Four Sides'.

8.name: The Wiggly Medley
8.overview: Dance along to 'The Gumtree Groove', get creative as Lucia spends time drawing, rehearse with The Wiggles and Buddy, and enjoy 'The Hokey Pokey'.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: The Wiggly Medley
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Dance along to 'The Gumtree Groove', get creative as Lucia spends time drawing, rehearse with The Wiggles and Buddy, and enjoy 'The Hokey Pokey'.
